_comment_TargetGroup: CUSTOMIZE: Set the directory group sAMAccountName. Only direct membership is checked.
_comment_WindowStart: CUSTOMIZE: Set the inclusive local-time start in HH:mm.
_comment_WindowEnd: CUSTOMIZE: Set the exclusive local-time end in HH:mm. Earlier than start means overnight.
_comment_DailyBudgetMinutes: CUSTOMIZE: Set the per-account daily observed usage budget in minutes.
_comment_WarningMinutes: CUSTOMIZE: Set warning lead times in minutes, or an empty array for no advance warnings.
_comment_StatePath: CUSTOMIZE: Set a new local folder under a protected parent. Install stores code, effective config, state and log here.
_comment_TaskName: CUSTOMIZE: Set a unique scheduled task name in the root task folder.
